claim.quote: A 90 % confidence level upper limit on spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section of $4.3 \times10^{2}$ pb for WIMPs with the mass of 150 GeV/$c^2$ is obtained.

key_value.note: 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit at 150 GeV/c^2.
key_value.quote: $4.3 \times10^{2}$ pb for WIMPs with the mass of 150 GeV/$c^2$

name: First limits from a 3d-vector directional dark matter search with the NEWAGE-0.3b' detector

summary.plain: NEWAGE made the first dark matter search that tracked recoils in three dimensions and could tell the head from the tail of a track. About 4.5 kg days of data gave a spin-dependent limit of about 430 pb at 150 GeV/c^2.
summary.technical: NEWAGE-0.3b', July 2013 to August 2017 (Run14-Run18), 434.85 live days = 4.51 kg d: first directional search with 3D tracking and head-tail sensitivity (3d-vector analysis); 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit 4.3e2 pb at 150 GeV/c^2.

title: First limits from a 3d-vector directional dark matter search with the NEWAGE-0.3b' detector
why_it_matters: The abstract describes it as the first directional dark matter search with three-dimensional tracking with head-tail sensitivity.
